Allows the player to walk on foliage blocks.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.passablef: Move through leaves and configured foliage blocks.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.passablef: Move through leaves and configured foliage blocks.
passablefoliage.config.alwaysLeafWalking: Always consider the player to have the Leaf Walker enchantment. When enabled, the recipe is hidden and foliage slowdown is ignored.
passablefoliage.config.alwaysNotViewBloc: Prevents foliage from blocking the player's view.
passablefoliage.config.fallDamageMultipl: Percentage of normal fall damage taken when landing in leaves.
passablefoliage.config.fallDamageThresho: Fall distance required before landing in leaves causes damage.
passablefoliage.config.headHitter.desc: Restores leaf collision above entities so they cannot pass through foliage from below.
passablefoliage.config.leafWalkerEnabled: Enables the Leaf Walker enchantment and its recipe.
passablefoliage.config.modifyPathFinding: Allows entities to recognize passable foliage as open space.
passablefoliage.config.playerOnly.desc: Only players can pass through foliage.
passablefoliage.config.sounds.volume.des: Volume of sounds produced while moving through foliage.
passablefoliage.config.speedMultiplierHo: Horizontal movement speed while inside foliage.
passablefoliage.config.speedMultiplierVe: Vertical movement speed while inside foliage.
